item.title: Lane closures planned on Hoover Road in Pender County
item.description: Drivers in Pender County should prepare for lane closures on Hoover Road near Hampstead beginning Monday as the North Carolina Department of Transportation starts a road improvement project.

item.title: Dow drops 900 after oil prices jump to highest in nearly 2 years and data show a slowing US economy
item.description: U.S. stocks are falling sharply Friday after getting a whiff of a worst-case scenario for financial markets: a weakening economy combined with high inflation.

item.title: Wilmington habitual felon sentenced to prison in firearm, break-in case
item.description: A Wilmington man with multiple prior felony convictions has been sentenced to prison after pleading guilty to firearm and property crimes in New Hanover County.

item.title: Comedy dog show “Mutts Gone Nuts” coming to Thalian Hall this weekend
item.description: A family-friendly comedy dog show featuring rescue dogs performing impressive tricks is coming to Thalian Hall this weekend.

item.title: IRS reminds taxpayers to watch out for tax scams for 2026
item.description: The Internal Revenue Service announced its annual Dirty Dozen list of tax scams for 2026 that threaten the tax and financial information of taxpayers, businesses, and tax professionals.

item.title: Fishermen swap crab fishing for cleanup, retrieving hundreds of lost crab pots from waterways
item.description: Local fishing crews are taking to regional waterways this week to retrieve lost fishing gear and crab pots. The North Carolina Coastal Federation said abandoned gear can pose a great threat to the environment and boaters.

item.title: North Carolina star Caleb Wilson breaks right thumb in practice and is out for the season
item.description: Caleb Wilson appeared to be close to returning for No. 17 North Carolina from a fracture to his left hand, just in time for the peak of March.

item.title: Americans stuck in the Middle East recount finding their way home with little government help
item.description: Alyssa Ramos' evacuation from Kuwait took 48 hours and carried her across four continents. The U.S. government did not help with any part of it, the travel blogger said.

item.description: What happens next, after Rick Southerland drops out.

item.title: New acting studio honors loved one who died of Pancreatic Cancer
item.description: PTPT Studio is a new acting program, promoting a new way to teach and learn about the theatre arts, no matter what age or experience you have.
